column1: S3 image resize pipeline (presigned upload -> resize Lambda -> 1200px JPEG in processed/ + 400px thumbnail in thumbnails/, delete from raw/)

column8: Deployed 2026-09-16: swarasa-resize-dev Lambda confirmed live (State=Active, running the real commit-tagged image, not the :bootstrap placeholder).
